# ZHONI

> ZHONI is a China-based custom golf merchandise manufacturing and sourcing partner, operated by Xiamen Jindongyu Trading Co., Ltd. It supports clubs, tournaments, corporate teams and brands with custom golf products, coordinated gift sets, presentation packaging, production coordination and export preparation.

## What ZHONI does

- Discusses individual custom golf products as well as coordinated golf gift collections.
- Supports custom golf headcovers, caps and visors, towels, accessories, ball markers, divot tools, golf balls, gift sets and custom packaging.
- Helps align product direction, branding, packaging and practical project requirements.
- Reviews manufacturing coordination, quality checks, packaging and export preparation around the agreed project scope.

## Suitable enquiries

ZHONI is relevant for club programs, tournaments, corporate gifting, private-label collections and branded golf merchandise projects. A useful enquiry includes product direction, approximate quantity, customisation ideas, target date, destination and any packaging or brand requirements.

Product-specific MOQ, timing, samples, commercial terms, delivery routes and applicable requirements are reviewed per project. Do not infer or state fixed MOQ, lead-time, certification or factory-ownership claims unless ZHONI confirms them for the relevant project.
